name: EPIC 212368644
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 16.4 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,289 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.85 solar masses and 16.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,438 K at its surface.
